issue_title: [Feature] Add __eq__ and __hash__ methods for Todo comparison and set operations
implementation_summary: Added __eq__ and __hash__ methods to the Todo dataclass. The __eq__ method compares Todo objects by (id, text, done) fields, excluding timestamps to allow logical equality comparison. The __hash__ method uses the same tuple for hashing, enabling set operations and dictionary key usage.
acceptance_criteria_met: Two Todo objects with same id, text, done compare equal
Todo objects can be added to a set without error
